premises: Adding ~15% Al2O3 to TaNbVTi-based RHEA via ball-milling and SPS forms TiO precipitates in situ.
The TiO precipitates provide solid solution and precipitation strengthening at high temperature.
The 15% Al2O3 addition increases compressive yield strength by ~32% and reduces density by ~15%.
Room-temperature ductility is retained in the Al2O3-added alloy.
